essence: Feast announced: somehow-won sweetness, success dealings, all-state worship, touch-feasts, equinox tides, startless deeds, dreaming rulers, chanter grades, nectar-weddings, churn-born winnings (vv1-10).
Feast entered: pure-shine rounds, woven weddings, waxing greed, ocean sitting, knot severing, sense-field sending, helpless heats, grace-causes, deed-frenzies, ventured fruits (vv11-22).

Feast deepened: roaming madness, open hearts, unfound beauties, clear-fed frames, wedding-bonds, thirsting lakes, sole bowls, somehow-wins, bowed gear, mantra-laid starts, blooming kingdoms (vv23-34).

Feast sealed: god-or-freed feasters, weighted guises, churned nectar, wish-cow deeming, tossing glances, churned worship, treading courtesy, unbarred love, stilled minds, ruled means, treasuried senses, pretty thralls, formed feasts, lust-offerings, straw-and-jewel close (vv35-48).

sections.SUMMARY: The longest song is a catalogue proving nothing is outside the festival: tears tasting nectar (1); all acts succeeding, devotees as successes (2); all beings worshipping unceasing (3); touch perfected by meditation (4); equinox-moment always (5); beginningless deed, single resort (6); gods fortunate even in delusion (7); whenever-wherever worship (8); incomparable enjoyers (9); the festival known only by getting (10); worship with all 36 tattva-acts (11); time spent in joy (12); greed growing daily (13); dwelling in His ocean (14); mind offered as sweet (15); senses sent as errands (16); drowning as sole liberation-route (17); perpetual foot-festival as grace-cause (18); moment-by-moment tasting (19); seen fruit (20); untasted happiness till then (21); effortless abiding (22); omnicompetent madness (23); unbegging worship praised (24); everything-is (25); utensil-body (26); dependent self-will (27); thirst quenched into lake (28); devotee as vessel like Him (29); festival agitating the 36 (30); instruments worshipped (31); mantra-placement then rest (32); kingdoms blooming (33); gods-freed-or-someone unanswered (34); lightness and weight (35); milk-ocean churning (36); wish-cow vs inward milking (37); glances feeding (38); lowliness crowned (39); steps for some, spread for devotees (40); divine foothold through madness (41); stunned mind, He alone as vessel (42); full-steady-devoted means (43); organ-host fortune (44); prettiness found (45); rising from formed or formless (46); passions conscripted (47); straw-yet-jewel close (48).

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of festival (utsava); the vyabhicāri is joy (harṣa) at the catalogue of all beings worshipping. The rasa is the bliss of the festival — everything inside, nothing outside. Abhinava's rasa theory frames this as ānanda: the relish (camatkāra) of the Absolute's festival. Lakshmanjoo: the festival agitates the 36 tattvas; the devotee is a vessel like Him. Everything is inside the festival; nothing outside. The rasa is the bliss of the festival — all beings worshipping, all acts succeeding.
